senses.gloss: m. (vivarium, βιβάριον) vivarium, an enclosure in which live game, fish &c. (also wild beasts) are kept.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:10">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>לשדיוה לב׳</he> must be thrown into the vivarium.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>שדיוה וכ׳</he> they threw him &c. but they (the beasts) did not eat him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:1">Ib. III, 1</cite>; a. fr. v. <cite ref="B00550"><he>בִּיבָרְיָא</he></cite>.
